connector.name: Gemini MCP by chrischall
connector.registryDescription: Generate and edit images with Google Gemini (Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro) image models.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gemini-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the chrischall account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GEMINI_IMAGE_MODEL
env.description: Override the default image model (default: gemini-3.1-flash-image)

env.name: GEMINI_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Default directory for generated images (default: current working directory)

env.name: GEMINI_INPUT_DIR
env.description: Directory to resolve bare input-image filenames against
